summary.text: Elaine Sena Cortez is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 62 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a business owner and professor.

paragraphs.text: Sena Cortez was born in Roswell, New Mexico.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Southwest in 2006, a graduate degree from Eastern New Mexico University in 2012 and a doctorate from the University of the Southwest.
Her career experience includes working as a business owner and professor.
